Glance Prognosis.name: Glance Prognosis
Glance Prognosis.description: For the rest of the scene the user no longer needs touch: meeting a person's eyes is enough, and with one sweep of the eyes across a room or a crowded platform they read everyone who looks back, seeing about an hour of each of their coming lives. A whole hostage room, a squad of villains or a panicking crowd is read in a breath, and the user knows who will run, who will fight and who will be hurt. When the scene ends the user cannot use the Quirk until they have slept. Strain: severe.
